assertion: step 1 runs the contract's verify and the local scripts the contract declares (version bump, changelog), and step 6 runs the redaction scan before any push; each script stops the run on a non-zero exit
cmd: python3 scripts/redact_scan.py --selfcheck && python3 scripts/version_bump.py --selfcheck && python3 scripts/changelog_edit.py --selfcheck

assertion: the real-test step INVOKES real-testing rather than reading a verdict somebody else happened to leave, and is done only when realtest_gate.py accepts the current tree
a repository without the real_test contract is recorded as mode: reduced naming the missing field, never skipped in silence
cmd: grep -q 'mode: reduced' SKILL.md && grep -q 'mode: reduced' references/contract.md

assertion: the deploy step reads the workflow named by the repo contract (_polaris/config.yml real_test.deploy_prod_workflow) instead of hardcoding a per-platform command
the real-test verdict is re-checked against the current tree by content hash, so a renamed or stale verdict cannot pass on its filename
Phase B requeries the live PR state before acting and merges at most once; a non-zero exit triggers a requery, never a second gh pr merge

when every gate holds on the current head the run stops at ONE proposal (plain first line, linked evidence, rollback plan, pre-deploy check, UNKNOWN for missing data) and nothing merges or deploys before the owner's yes
cmd: grep -qF 'nothing runs until the owner says' SKILL.md && grep -qF 'nothing runs until the owner says' references/merge-and-deploy.md && grep -qF 'Rollback plan:' references/merge-and-deploy.md

assertion: the canary alerts on change from the captured baseline with a debounce, not on an absolute value: an already-erroring page stays silent, a new error alerts on the second consecutive check
the post-deploy verification window advances, holds or proposes a rollback from baseline-relative metrics, and a missing metric holds instead of advancing

the steps run in this order: local tests, the review audit (no separate simplify or security pass), local real-testing with a fresh-context breaker, the DoD, the docs step, push and draft PR, staging once, pr, babysit, then merge and plan close
cmd: python3 -c "import re,sys; s=open('SKILL.md').read(); keys=['Local tests','Review.','Real-test locally','DoD.','Docs.','Push and PR','Staging, once','Body.','Owner','Merge and close']; idx=[s.index('**'+k) for k in keys]; sys.exit(0 if idx==sorted(idx) else 1)"

assertion: before the PR, every doc whose claim the diff changed is either fixed on the branch or named under «Still open» in the PR body; none is left stale and unnamed
Tiny and Bug work skips staging; Medium and Large work holds staging exactly once, and a second round happens only after a code push voids the receipt
cmd: grep -qF '**Tiny** and **Bug** skip step 7' SKILL.md && grep -qF 'Staging, once' SKILL.md

assertion: after the merge the run converges Git (git-power phase finalize) and runs phase 8 (plan close) when a plan file exists; it never leaves closing to the end of the session
